aana: हरियो रुमाल, लाल किनारी। पेट मा बच्चा, डाल मा दुलारी।
english_hint: Green bird with red beak that nests in tree hollows.

aana: एक थान कपड़ो, सारी दुनिया डांकै।
english_hint: A single giant sheet covering the whole earth.

aana: कांठा मा बठ्यूं, सबु तैं देखदु, आपु कखि नी जांदु।
english_hint: Sits high on the ridge, overlooks all valleys, but never walks.

aana: काली गैया काठ खांदी, पाणि पींदा मरी जांदी।
english_hint: Black creature that eats dry firewood and dies instantly with water.

aana: दिन मा धाण, रात मा पाण।
english_hint: Works all day on roads, rests quietly at night under the bed.

aana: कटोरी मा कटोरी, बेटा बाप से भी गोरी।
english_hint: Outer shell is dark and rough, inner kernel is white.
